name: GET /api/sla/policies - List SLA policies in evaluation order
description: Returns every SLA policy in ascending evaluation_order - the exact order the matcher walks them - so an operator reading the list can see which policy a given lead type will actually hit. First match wins, and a policy with source_channel null is the catch-all, so a catch-all placed at a low evaluation_order shadows everything after it; listing in evaluation order is what makes that mistake visible. A read, so it answers 200. Pass active=true to omit retired policies; by default retired ones are included, because a retired policy still explains why a lead captured last week had the deadline it had. effective_default_minutes reports the flat fallback (30) applied when no policy matches, so the reader never has to guess what an unmatched lead gets. Protected by the authenticate guard - the Authorization header is required on this GET. QA: depends on register, login and a created policy so the list is non-empty.

errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, or present without a Bearer token
the bearer token fails verification or has expired
